fold_assignment: Randomized person-level assignment; all observed waves of each person remain together.
cv_intervals: Conditional on out-of-fold fits; no nested refit.
mirror_intervals: Person-cluster bootstrap, refitting human OLS in each resample.
format: Orthogonal moment decomposition; cross-item covariance retained; negative component estimates not truncated.
order: Single reversed call; variance decomposition depends on reverse/original noise covariance assumption. Multipliers .5,1,2.
